A farmhouse hutch shelf of painted cream wood anchors the foreground, its bead-board back visible behind the shelf edge; stacked blue-and-white china plates rise in the midground, catching a slant of late-afternoon sun from a nearby window; a curl of dried bittersweet vine drapes along the shelf's far edge into soft amber shadow.

An old steamer-trunk lid propped open fills the foreground, its curved top covered in faded travel labels and brass tacks; layers of folded tissue and crumpled brown paper spill over the trunk's edge into the midground; a single bare attic bulb swings gently above, casting a warm cone of yellow light across the rafters beyond.

A church-bazaar folding table draped in a red-and-white checkered cloth anchors the foreground, the cloth's edge hanging in neat folds; a hand-lettered price placard stands out of focus in the midground beside a mason jar of dried marigolds; tall parish hall windows let in pale grey afternoon light across the back wall behind.

A one-room schoolhouse windowsill of wide pine boards holds the foreground, a stack of black-and-white marbled composition books leaning against the window frame to one side; afternoon light filters through old wavy glass in the midground, scattering golden refractions across the sill; a chalkboard fades to dusty grey-green in the classroom beyond.

An old barbershop counter of white tile and black-edged porcelain spreads across the foreground, its surface clean and cool; a tall glass jar of red-and-white peppermint sticks stands in the midground, backlit by a globe light that turns the candy translucent ruby; the mirrored back wall doubles the warm bulb glow into the distance.

A soda-fountain counter of white marble and chrome trim anchors the foreground, its surface cool and bright; a chrome napkin dispenser catches the overhead light in the midground, its reflection curved and warm; a row of spinning stools recedes along the counter into the fountain's cheerful amber back-lit glow beyond.

A front-hall side table of dark cherry wood holds the foreground, a small brass dish for keys resting to one side; a coat rack rises in the midground behind it, hung with a plaid wool scarf and a caramel-colored autumn jacket; the hall's narrow window lets in a last slant of blue-gold dusk beyond the rack.

A sewing-room shelf of pale pine spans the foreground, spools of amber and rust thread arranged along its edge; a wooden spool cabinet stands in the midground behind, its many small drawers catching the glow of a goose-neck lamp; the room beyond fades into the warm ivory of lace curtains and soft afternoon light.

A diner counter of speckled grey Formica and chrome edging crosses the foreground, its surface catching overhead fluorescent warmth; a tall fluted milkshake glass stands in the midground, condensation beading on its cold sides in the amber light; a row of chrome-capped stools recedes into the diner's cozy back glow beyond.

A small-town post-office counter of scarred dark oak anchors the foreground, a stack of brown paper parcels tied with twine resting at one end; a brass postal scale gleams in the midground under a hanging incandescent bulb warm and golden; rows of small brass P.O. box doors recede into the back room's amber shadow beyond.
